ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white and light-grey pixel mottling is mapped to the mid-to-lateral regions of both lobes, radiating outward from a central region of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center of the trailing edge with an estimated pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary exhibiting irregular serrations with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, increasing in frequency toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the outer boundaries of both fluke lobes, sweeping upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, high-texture white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of high-intensity, textured white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, representing significant localized surface anomalies.
